## Statements

- Stated by harness (grok-sandbox, Profiles table and Enable a profile): Grok Build runs with no sandbox unless you pass --sandbox <profile> (workspace, read-only, strict). Set one for untrusted repositories or review-only runs.
- Stated by harness (grok-project-rules, Discovery): Grok Build loads CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and .grok/rules/*.md from the repo root down to the working directory, so a dispatched run inherits those instructions.
- Stated by harness (grok-headless, Suppressing updates in xai-grok-shell): Pass --no-auto-update on scripted or CI runs of grok -p or grok agent stdio so background update checks do not run.
